prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated Runelord Runeblade inventory relic icon. The supplied knight is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, do not depict a character. Match serious 2D cel-shading, broad flat regions, two or three crisp hard shadow tones, chunky silhouette, steel gray, deep navy, bone ivory and ice cyan. Quiet surfaces, few large functional details, strong dark contours, no PBR realism, no painterly gradients, no bloom or decorative clutter. Square canvas, whole object centered with generous clear padding; genuine transparent background, no frame, scenery, text, lettering or watermark. Must read clearly at 128px. Subject: A short warbanner relic on a stout dark shaft with an angular steel spearhead, ragged navy hanging cloth with ONE bold ivory stitched bone emblem, two broad visible stitches and one cyan ice gem securing the crossbar. Compact vertical silhouette, complete pole and fabric visible. Strengthens undead summons.

visualQA.fullSize: Passed: complete distinct silhouette, serious steel/navy/cyan cel shading, no scenery or text
visualQA.nativeSize: Passed at 128px on dark and ivory backgrounds: distinct silhouettes, clean alpha edges, readable central symbols; narrow banner is intentionally slender.
